Class ConsoleUI

java.lang.Object
console.ConsoleUI
public class ConsoleUI extends Object
Reads user choices and displays results for the vehicle rental application. Rental rules are delegated to Inventory, keeping terminal input and output separate from the application's core logic.

    • run

      public void run()
      Displays the menu repeatedly until the user chooses Exit or input ends. Invalid menu text is handled by readInteger(String).

    • rentVehicle

      private void rentVehicle()
      Collects rental details and asks Inventory to begin the rental. Invalid IDs and unavailable vehicles are rejected before customer details are collected.
